items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I met Hazel in about 1970, and we became like sisters.

ctx.x: You had an opportunity to play with Dizzy Gillespie?

Yes, at the Newport Jazz Festival in 1968 I did, and that was a thrill, and I got to know him as a person. And I got to know Mahalia Jackson, because when I went to Europe with Basie she was just so taken aback about me playing and singing with the band. She remarked to me, “Hey girl, whatchya doin’ up there? Don’t you know I’m the star?” And she would call me, and we got to be good friends, whenever she called or came out to L.A. And Sarah, she was a friend of mine and I thank God that I have had the pleasure of…
Dolphy of course, I’ve known him since school days. I’m playing a mouthpiece he gave me before he left Los Angeles.
